target.title: refactor(voice-call): reuse shared webhook path normalization
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Voice-call maintained two local copies of the same webhook path normalization already provided by the Plugin SDK. That duplicated path-matching policy across config derivation, realtime routing, HTTP webhook matching, and websocket route matching.

## Why This Change Was Made

Reuse `normalizeWebhookPath` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/webhook-ingress` for all exact voice-call callers and delete the plugin-local helper. Slack and SMS path helpers remain separate because their default and trailing-slash contracts differ.

AI-assisted change; the implementation and proof were reviewed against the full affected voice-call call paths and the Plugin SDK helper contract.

## User Impact

No user-visible behavior change. Voice-call webhook and realtime paths keep the same trimming, leading-slash, root-path, and trailing-slash behavior through one canonical helper.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/voice-call/src/config.test.ts extensions/voice-call/src/webhook/realtime-handler.test.ts extensions/voice-call/src/webhook.test.ts` — 3 files, 93 tests passed.
- Testbox-through-Crabbox `tbx_01kwner4fgkbcbq6fe689ck3e0`, Actions run `28691942717` — `pnpm check:changed` passed, including extension production/test typechecks, extension lint, guard checks, and zero runtime value import cycles.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local --stream-engine-output` — clean; no accepted/actionable findings, correctness confidence 0.99.
- Production diff: +10/-36 lines; one duplicate helper file and one private duplicate implementation removed.
